name: Zap
text: Range: 8. Damage: 1d8+4. On miss: you take half the damage instead.

name: Overload
restriction: Castable only if Charged, ending the condition.
text: Castable only if Charged, ending the condition. Reach: 2, AoE. Damage: 2d8.

source.note: The "Charged." sidebar printed under this spell is a general condition definition, not part of the spell, so it is not in text.

name: Arc Lightning
text: Range: 12. Damage: 3d8. Also hits the next closest creature. Next Closest Creature. If you are the closest, you are hit! If 2 creatures are equally close, the GM can select randomly, the taller one, or whoever has the most metal.

source.note: Header reads "TIER 1, 1+ TARGET"; the schema has no field for "1+ TARGET", so it is not stored (aoe false). "Next Closest Creature." is a sidebar box printed under the spell (after the Upcast line); appended to text.

name: Alacrity
text: (1/turn) Teleport up to your Speed, gain Charged (can be cast while Defending, after damage).

source.note: The (1/turn) is printed in the body text, not next to the name, so no limit or restriction is set (same as Heart’s Fire; question for rules owner).

name: Stormlash
text: Line: 12, AoE. Damage: 3d8+4 and Prone on a failed STR save. Creatures with a large amount of metal (e.g., armor or a longsword) roll with disadvantage and suffer +10 damage.

source.note: The field is printed "Line: 12, AoE." (not Reach/Range); stored in reach as "Line 12, AoE" (interpretation). The STR save decides Prone, not half damage, so no save is encoded; the +10 vs metal is text only.

name: Electrickery
restriction: Castable when an ally is attacked.
text: Castable when an ally is attacked. Range: 8. Teleport an ally away. Teleport another creature there on a failed WIL save (making them the target). Costs 1 action if Charged, ending the condition.

name: Electrocharge
text: Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 4. Give a creature Charged, +1 max action, +5 Defense, 2× Speed, and advantage on DEX saves.

name: Ride the Lightning
text: Reach: 12, AoE. Teleport to a spot you can see (if a willing creature is there, swap places with them). Adjacent creatures take d88 damage and Knockback 2. Creatures moved 2+ spaces are also knocked Prone, Dazed, and deafened for 1 day.

source.note: The "D88." sidebar printed under this spell is the general definition of d88 dice (also used by Seething Storm, and handled by the dice engine), not spell-specific, so it is not in text (question for rules owner).

name: Seething Storm
text: Concentration: 1 min. Become a cloud of tempestuous storm. You can fly, move for free 1/round, and attacks against you are disadvantaged. At the end of each of your turns, strike up to 4 creatures within Reach 4 with a bolt of lightning for d88 damage (a creature can only be struck 1/round). Costs 3 actions each round to maintain. +2 Reach and +2 lightning bolts each round. Note. Once you cast this spell, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before you can use it again.

source.note: The line below the rule (where Upcast normally sits) has no "Upcast:" label: "Costs 3 actions each round to maintain. +2 Reach and +2 lightning bolts each round." It is kept in text and upcast is left empty (question for rules owner: is the second sentence the Upcast?). No Reach:/Range: field is printed; the effect names Reach 4. "Note." is a sidebar box; appended to text. Roll is the d88 per bolt.

name: Spark Buddy
text: Conjure a Tiny (squirrel-sized) helper for up to 1 hour. It can fetch Tiny objects, open unlocked doors, illuminate a small area, or deliver a harmless shock. If it takes damage or moves further than 6 spaces away from you, it dissipates into sparks.

name: Spark Step
text: Reach: 4. Teleport to a metal object.

name: Tempest’s Command
text: Dispel a minor magical effect, or temporarily suppress a stronger one (the more powerful an enchantment, the shorter the duration). OR: Your eyes glow and your voice is amplified to a thunder-like volume for 1 min.
